response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial credentials (GISCollective, Green Map web GIS, FOSS4G talk) and real low-latency distributed systems work at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby handling millions of requests per second, which maps well to the pipeline and reliability aspects of the role. However, the core requirement — modern C++ (or Rust) in commercial or open-source settings — is essentially unmet: his only C/C++ exposure is a 6-month stint at National Instruments in 2014-2015 plus a university thesis project, with the last decade spent primarily in TypeScript/Node.js and D. There is no evidence of navigation guidance, routing tile generation, or map data pipeline work. He may be a fast learner with strong systems fundamentals and D's C-adjacent performance work is a partial proxy, but he would be a stretch hire requiring significant ramp-up on the primary language stack.
strengths: Deep geospatial/GIS domain experience via GISCollective and Green Map
Proven low-latency, high-throughput distributed services work (millions of req/s)
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, built test tooling, Linux/DevOps depth
concerns: No modern C++ or Rust experience; last C/C++ work was ~2014 for 6 months
Recent decade dominated by TypeScript/Node.js web and full-stack work
No navigation guidance, routing, or map-tiling pipeline background
